logp.method_description: The partition coefficient was measured in a method which was previously reported.[22] In a 2 ml centrifuge tube, 0.1 ml of the 99mTc-complex was mixed with 0.7 ml of the 1-octanol and 0.6 ml of phosphate buffer (0.025 mol/l, pH 7.4). After shaking on a vortex mixer for 3 min, the mixture was centrifuged at 10000 g for 5 min. Three samples (100 μL) from 1-octanol and phosphate buffer were pipetted and measured in a Gamma Counter, and each group was repeated three times. The partition coefficient was calculated as follows: Log P = Log [(counts in 1-octanol layer)/(counts in aqueous layer)]. The final results were expressed as the mean ± SD (standard deviation).
